faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 is 03 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which WCD Odisha is recruiting?
faq.answer: WCD Odisha is recruiting for the posts of Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by WCD Odisha?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies have been announced for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts by WCD Odisha.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years for all the posts. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th class from a recognized board to be eligible for the Anganwadi Worker post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Helper?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 8th class from a recognized board to be eligible for the Anganwadi Helper post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 7500/- per month for Anganwadi Worker and Rs. 4500/- per month for Anganwadi Helper.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline by downloading the form from the official website and sending it via post along with required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification and the preparation of a Merit List based on the qualifications and documents submitted.
